reuse.why: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link body and the download function are new copies of the per-provider ones rather than shared code.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the ~60-line upgrade-or-create/payee/sync/notify body of the other link functions, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadEnableBankingTransactions with the URL and log changed.

placement.why: Handler in accounts/app.ts, download and balance handling in sync.ts (the akahu branch is extended rather than copied), URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models, matching the tree.

scope.why: Only the new provider, its config, types and tests.

maintainability.why: It follows the tree's per-provider copy convention faithfully, so it is easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and another download copy that must be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The shared guard and bank/sync helpers are used; there is no shared link-body abstraction in the tree to go around.

disguised_duplication.where: Both copies are open, near-verbatim repetitions.
